Complete saved product/test diffs, current functions, decision issuance/readback, recursive transition/source validation, dependency pins, fixture construction and both contract additions are consistent. Validation precedes budget, contract-error, provider-error and normal applied/empty selection. Keep context, rerank, verify, semantic reducer, follow-up, deadline and public start/step/run work outside the next batch unless its authorized directive explicitly selects them.

Continue synthetic/offline validation with no real provider/model/clock/private-data activity or changes to baseline, corpus, gold, evaluation or runtime configuration. Keep measured quality and implementation acceptance separate.

Integrate only the reviewed candidate and its bound contract documents, preserving unrelated dirty files. Any behavior, contract or required-evidence change requires a new candidate and review; closeout-only records may remain separate.
